item: row 313: no write follows a link in a backup, export or staging folder
key_paths: src/backup/regular_file.py src/safety/crypto.py src/backup/volumes.py src/backup/parity.py src/backup/stream_backup.py src/backup/export_summary.py src/backup/folder_backup.py src/backup/artifact.py src/static/app-core.js src/static/locales/ docs/USER_MANUAL.md docs/i18n/
summary: create_new (remove the name as itself, then O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW; folders and Windows name-surrogate reparse points refused) and replace_with (a temporary made that way, then a rename) now carry every write into a backup, export or restore-staging folder: volumes, manifests, the building record, parity and its rebuild, the export summary, the folder-backup manifest, the single-file backup and the restore working copies; a link planted at any of those names is replaced, never written through; a category or sub folder inside a folder backup that is a link stops the large-data copy before any file is copied, naming the folder, where it points and what to do (x12, and the Help in 12 languages)
